name: L10 SEVN independent EasyOCR CRAFT exact-token fallback fresh PAN Development
question: Can a source-diverse CRAFT plus English-G2 full-view exact-token observation materially improve V2 OCR and address-to-door binding on forty additional fresh SEVN PAN episodes without weakening precision?

cohort.disjointness: No address or panorama frame may overlap any of the four earlier SEVN panels; no frame may be reused across new episodes.

runtime.fallback_ocr_backend: EasyOCR 1.7.2 with CRAFT detector and English-G2 recognizer on CUDA, local weights only
runtime.archive_integrity: Reuse the hash-bound full-archive MD5 receipt, verify current byte size, and record ZIP-member CRC plus SHA-256 for every selected panorama.

easyocr_observation.trigger: Run only when V2 emits no selected binding and its state is UNKNOWN_TARGET_TEXT or UNKNOWN_NO_ADMISSIBLE_MASK_TOPOLOGY.
easyocr_observation.scope: One full 1440 by 1280 action-result viewport; no portal crops, tiles, rotations, super-resolution, temporal context, or evaluator labels.
easyocr_observation.identity_rule: Delete punctuation and spaces, then require exact equality to the requested house number. The full EasyOCR box owns the token; no fuzzy, substring, sub-token, character repair, or target-conditioned recognition is allowed.
easyocr_observation.unique_admission: Zero exact boxes preserves UNKNOWN. More than one exact box is an explicit set and preserves UNKNOWN. Exactly one exact box may enter the unchanged V2 mask-topology admission and ranking.
easyocr_observation.asymmetry: Never run after a V2 proposal and never replace, rerank, or revoke a V2 proposal.

representation_boundary: The only new information is an independent CRAFT plus English-G2 full-view lexical observation and its detection box on V2-abstaining episodes. Renderer, prescribed PAN action, PP-OCRv6 baseline, portal weights and masks, spatial radii, topology admission and ranking, evaluator projection, and mask correctness remain fixed. Evaluator labels enter only after both outputs are sealed in memory.
execution_rule: Freeze source, evaluator, runtime, weights, EasyOCR parameters, exact-box semantics, hashes, metrics, and gates before opening any selected panorama member. Run one output-bearing invocation. Do not tune the model, parameters, trigger, admission, topology, gates, cohort, or runtime after observing results.
non_claims: The panel is same-source SEVN and PAN-only; it does not confirm a new city, provider, or APPROACH behavior.
An independent exact-token fallback is Development binding evidence, not proof of portal ownership, public access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, HANDOFF_READY, user benefit, or safety.
Mask correctness uses evaluator door annotations after inference and does not enter OCR, topology, proposal generation, or selection.
A failed gate closes only this frozen EasyOCR fallback on this cohort; UNKNOWN remains unknown rather than negative evidence.
